title.rendered: Your Kingdom Come | Teach Me How to Pray, Day 3

excerpt.rendered: Most prayer begins with the believer’s agenda. Jesus taught His disciples to begin with the Father’s Kingdom and will. That reorientation changes the authority of every prayer.

content.rendered:
Most prayer begins with the believer’s agenda. The need. The problem. The crisis. Jesus taught His disciples to begin with a different agenda entirely. The Father’s Kingdom and the Father’s will. That reorientation changes the authority of every prayer that follows it.

The Gospel For Today | Monday, October 5, 2026 | Teach Me How to Pray, Day 3

Today’s Scripture

“Your kingdom come. Your will be done on earth as it is in heaven.”
Matthew 6:10 (NKJV)

Today’s Message

In most natural human praying, the agenda is the human’s. The believer brings a list of needs, a set of concerns, a crisis to be averted, a situation to be fixed, a healing to be received. All of these are legitimate. Jesus Himself taught His disciples to bring their needs to the Father. But He did not teach them to begin there. He taught them to begin with a radically different agenda. “Your kingdom come. Your will be done on earth as it is in heaven.” Before the believer brings a single personal request, the Lord’s Prayer orients the believer around the Father’s purposes. The Father’s reign. The Father’s will. The Father’s agenda in the earth.

This is not religious decoration. It is a reordering of the believer’s whole posture. In heaven, there is no sickness, no poverty, no fear, no demonic oppression, no injustice, no division. The Father’s will is fully done there. On earth, the Father’s will is contested. There are areas where the Kingdom has broken through, and areas where darkness still reigns. The believer’s prayer, Jesus taught, is to call for the Kingdom to come, and the Father’s will to be done, in the areas where it is not yet done. Not passive waiting. Active calling. The believer stands between heaven and earth and prays heaven’s reality into earth’s situations.

The Passion Translation renders Matthew 6:10 with striking force: “Manifest your kingdom realm, and cause your every purpose to be fulfilled on earth, just as it is fulfilled in heaven” (Matthew 6:10 TPT). The Amplified Bible Classic Edition adds: “Your kingdom come, Your will be done on earth as it is in heaven” (Matthew 6:10 AMPC). Manifest your kingdom realm. Cause your every purpose to be fulfilled. These are enforcement words. The believer in prayer is an enforcer of what heaven has already decreed, in the places on earth where it has not yet manifested.

How Jesus Prayed

The Format. Jesus taught the Kingdom petition before any personal petition. Daily bread, forgiveness, deliverance all come after this one. The order is deliberate. The Father’s agenda is settled first. The believer’s needs are brought in alignment with it, not in competition with it.

The Essence. This petition recognises that there is a gap between what is already true in heaven and what has not yet manifested on earth. Prayer is the believer’s privileged role in closing that gap. Heaven has already decided. Prayer calls heaven’s decision into earthly manifestation.

The Authority. This is one of the most authority-charged petitions in the whole Bible. The believer, rooted in Christ, authorised by the Spirit, is calling for the reign of God to break into situations where darkness has had the upper hand. Sickness. Oppression. Poverty. Injustice. Fear. The believer prays Kingdom-authority over all of it.

The Assurance. The assurance in this petition is total. The Father’s will is being done perfectly in heaven. The outcome is not in question. The only question is where in earth the believer will co-labour with the Father to see it manifested. Prayer is partnership with a Kingdom that is already winning.

The Submission. Here is the submission. The believer is praying for the Father’s Kingdom and will, not the believer’s. If the believer’s preferences conflict with the Father’s agenda, this petition surrenders the believer’s preferences in advance. Authority in prayer is always paired with submission to the Father’s purposes.

The Result. Kingdom-shaped prayer bears Kingdom-shaped fruit. Healings. Breakthroughs. Oppression lifted. Darkness pushed back. For Gospelbuzz readers today, wherever you are reading this from, in Lagos or London or Manila or Nairobi or Sao Paulo, learn to pray this petition over the areas of your life, your family, your city, where heaven’s reality has not yet been fully established. Your kingdom come, Father. Your will be done, Father. In this situation. In this body. In this family. In this nation. On earth as it is in heaven.

Prayer (Pattern After Jesus)

Address. Our Father in heaven, hallowed be Your name.

Kingdom Petition. Your kingdom come. Your will be done in [name the specific situation] on earth as it is in heaven. I call heaven’s reality into this circumstance. Where the enemy has had the upper hand, let Your reign break through today.

Submission. Your Kingdom, not mine. Your will, not mine. Let the gap between heaven and earth close in my life today.

In Jesus’ name. Amen.

Declaration

I am an enforcer of heaven’s reality on earth. The Father’s Kingdom is breaking through in every area of my life where I pray this petition. His will is being done, on earth as it is in heaven, through my prayers.
